https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/rnrwms/b
* Price: **$129.00**
* Customer rating: **4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)**
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* Returns: 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.

Everything else is identical, so the only trade-off is price vs. trust.

Buy B only if you absolutely want the lowest price and are okay with a lower-rated seller.
